headline: Project Coordinator
summary: Project coordinator with three years at a construction materials company running office renovation and branch opening projects. I keep plans, schedules and documents in Asana and in shared folders, run weekly check-ins, and make sure suppliers and teams know what is due.
skills: Project management principles: scope, schedule, budget

experience.title: Project Coordinator
bullets: Coordinated the opening of three branch stores, each on time and within 5% of budget.
Keep every project's tasks, owners and deadlines in Asana and send a weekly status summary.
Organise permits, contracts and turnover documents in one shared folder per project.

experience.title: Administrative Assistant
bullets: Supported the operations manager with scheduling, filing and supplier follow-ups.
Prepared meeting materials and took minutes for management meetings.

education.credential: Bachelor of Science in Industrial Engineering
